Unrealized losses, loss-cutting, unstoppable fluctuations… but she still wants to buy, sell and make money! With fellow FX addicts Mochiko, Mebuki and Yasuko along for the ride, the market heats up! Joy, despair, joy, despair — this is an endearing, yet slightly risky money game. Can Kurumi and her friends survive this turbulent world?

A great hero lies undefeated on her deathbed, regretting that she never found a foe who could take her down. She never intended to meet her fate anywhere other than on the battlefield, and her peaceful demise has her wishing desperately that things could have been different... But when she suddenly comes to in the body of the young, frail Nia Liston, she’s got an all-new fight ahead of her. Nia is a sickly child, meaning she has a long way to go before she’s in fighting form. Now that she’s been given a second shot at life, however, she’s determined to get what she wants. She’s going to live—and die—for battle this time! Make way for the Merciless Maiden!

206521.description:
Born into a life of acting and dance with a traveling theater troupe in 14th-century Japan, 12-year old Oniyasha has one problem—he doesn't know what the point of any of it is. "Why must I step with the left foot here instead of the right? Why is one performance good and another, bad? Why do people dance at all?" It all seems perfectly arbitrary, until a chance encounter in a run-down shack sets him down a path to revolutionizing the art form and influencing much of Japanese culture to come. A fictionalized account of the early life of Zeami Motokiyo (Oniyasha), the founder of modern Noh theater—the world's oldest surviving theater art—this coming-of-age artist's journey vividly brings to life a man far ahead of his time during one of Japan's most culturally and socially vibrant eras.

(Source: Kodansha Comics)

Note: World Is Dancing is streaming 3 days in advance of the TV broadcast on Prime Video and HIDIVE beginning June 29th, 2026. Regular broadcasting began on July 2nd, 2026.

Gu Feiyang, the third strongest warrior on the Tianwu Continent and the Martial Emperor Pojun, was bound by the world's rules, his cultivation stuck at the Nine Heavens Martial Emperor realm for many years, unable to break through. To escape this predicament, he used the affections of Qu Hongyan, the mistress of the Shenxiao Palace, to orchestrate a grand scheme, sacrificing extraterrestrial demonic energy to reincarnate and cultivate anew.

In his reincarnation, he was named Li Yunxiao, a 15-year-old boy from the Tianshui Kingdom and the eldest grandson of the Li family of the Marshal's Mansion. At this time, Tianshui was beset by powerful enemies invading from the outside and princes vying for the throne from within, making the Li family, who held military power, the center of a vortex of crisis. Faced with the power struggles of everyone, Li Yunxiao stood at a higher level, calmly breaking through the impasse. He deeply understood that in this world where martial arts reign supreme, all power ultimately came from within, and his goal remained singular: to complete the scheme laid out in his previous life and build a foundation for the Divine Realm.

What if you could control reality with a mouse cursor?

One day during class, Takumi— an otaku — notices his mouse cursor has sprung out of the screen.

Panicked, he asks his childhood friend Mone, sitting next to him, to take a look, only to be brushed off...

Once Takumi realizes he could actually control it himself, he uses the mouse cursor— visible only to him— to slip it in between Mone's clothes and starts clicking away...

Despite all my hard work, that guy... Mother Misako had fallen asleep, face-down on the living room table. The screen of her working laptop illuminated her voluptuous form in the darkness. Her ample curves, slipping off the table and swaying, were being kneaded by the hands of her beloved son, Majime...

These weren't feelings for a mother... Every time Majime became conscious of Misako, he was tormented by anguish. The secret his aunt Reika had taught him... As a mother, a wife, a female teacher, Misako poured her heart into her daily duties. She wanted to save her. The reality that suddenly descended upon him. The moment he heard that fact, the sound of the shackles binding his boiling son's rod snapped...

One day he discovers that a strange drug is spreading through the city which causes people's butts to move to the front. After infiltrating a pharmaceutical company, he uncovers the shocking "Oshirimae Man Empire Revival Plan," led by a mysterious villain burning with vengeance.

Can Oshirimae Man stop him before all of humanity finds its butt… in the front?

There, he learned that his homeland—the Nine Skies Continent—was on the brink of destruction. Without hesitation, Ye Cangxuan chose to return. At the same time, the Six Sects were collapsing. Demons and devils from the Outer Lands were poised to invade, and their spies had already infiltrated the Nine Skies Continent. Determined to change his homeland's fate, Ye Cangxuan embarked on a grueling quest. He reunited the Six Sects, broke into the Barbaric Wastes, wiped out demons and devils, and challenged the immortals themselves. In the end, he stood against the Sky itself.

Bok-joo turns this idea down and abruptly disappears. Oblivious to the danger he is putting the woman he loves in, Isak asks Myeong-jun, his assigned interpreter, for help. When Myeong-jun refuses, a desperate Isak becomes increasingly suspicious of everyone.

206140.description: The film is based on Chinese mythology such as Journey to the West, bringing together numerous gods and goddesses to tell the legendary story of low-ranking gods who defy fate and change their destiny in a chaotic world where faith has collapsed.

206195.description:
The Pure Sea's currents flow from north to south, constantly flowing through this world. People build homes and thrive on the backs of giant beasts. Every wish has its response. The deity known as Fan Ying warns that only by letting your wishes run wild can you reap the rewards of miracles and survive. However, the unchanging rules are about to change, and those who transcend fate will eventually follow the origin of all things.

(Source: Tencent, translated)

206276.description:
In an out-of-control world, survivors faced a thrilling and perilous apocalyptic battlefield.

(Source: Youku, translated)

206596.description: In 2145, a hundred years after the "New Humanity Project"—which was intended to fully unlock human potential—triggered a nuclear apocalypse, human survivors built a new social order upon the wastelands. In this world shaped by technology, supernatural powers, and magical arts, the only "complete new human", Jiang Li, awakened from his long slumber to begin his legendary journey.

206287.description: The young human Wang Dong vowed to avenge his parents and joined the Storm Squad, determined to exterminate the Zhage insect species across the solar system. Through hardships, he awakened his Blade Warrior powers, upgraded his armor and skills, and ultimately uncovered the insects' ultimate plot on Earth along with his team. Facing overwhelming swarms, Wang activated his ultimate Blade Warrior form and defeated both human traitors and the insect leader Ying Yuan.

title.romaji: Soreike! Anpanman: Pantan to Yakusoku no Hoshi
title.native: それいけ！アンパンマン　パンタンと約束の星

206682.description:
Pantan is a red panda who seeks to find the treasure thought to be in a rainbow star in the night sky, in order to keep a promise made to an adventurer long ago. When Pantan and Anpanman encounter each other, Anpanman lends his abilities to help out Pantan.

(Source: Anime News Network)

title.romaji: Luo Xiaohei Zhan Ji: Xue Qian Pian
title.native: 罗小黑战记 学前篇

206244.description: The third season of Luo Xiaohei Zhan Ji.

title.romaji: Luo Xiaohei Zhan Ji: Zhongsheng Zhi Men

206256.description:
Dongfang Shaohong, possessing two Dao bodies, but lacking the spiritual roots to awaken his spirit body, is ridiculed by his own clan and even betrayed by his fiancée. Troubles pile up one after another. Dongfang Shaohong's father, imprisoned for possessing the secret to entering the Cangyu Immortal Palace, is trapped by the Immortal Alliance. In the midst of his clan's crisis, Dongfang Shaohong inadvertently uses his own blood to activate the Dao Stone of Immortal Source within him, repelling the Immortal Alliance and saving the clan from the brink. In these dire straits, Dongfang Shaohong is fortunately rescued by his father's friend, Master Ji Yin, and is offered refuge within the Piaomiao Sect. Within the Taiyin Mountain ravine of the Piaomiao Sect, Dongfang Shaohong diligently cultivates, but possessing the Dark Night Dao Body of the Nether Clan is viewed as an anomaly among the human race and constantly harassed by his fellow disciples. Dongfang Shaohong realizes that only by becoming powerful enough can he rescue his father, clear his name, and expose the Immortal Alliance's conspiracy.

(Source: Bangumi, translated)
synonyms: Legend of the Misty Sword Immortal

206595.description:
Music video for the song Guruguru Live by Tsukasa Yuzaki (CV: Akari Kitou).

Note: The song featured in this music video also serves as the ending theme of the anime Tonikaku Kawaii: Joshikou-hen.

title.english: TONIKAWA: Over The Moon For You ~High School Days~
The Haunted House: The Sky Ghost VS Jormungandr
The Haunted House: The Secret of the Ghost Ball

206071.description:
Ordinary life repeats itself every day. The succession of moments that we repeat over and over again is never the same, and everything changes and wavers. The moment we touch something, our consciousness can go to a place that does not exist anywhere in the past, nor in the future. In an uncertain and fluctuating world, only the feeling of the body touching something, which exists only in this present reality, can be recognized as “now”. That moment is lovely.

(Source: YouTube description)

Note: Premiered at the 75th Berlin International Film Festival on February 15, 2025

title.romaji: Banjjakineun Ujeong Racing: Racer Hachuupinggwa Kkangchongpingui Tansaeng

title.native: 반짝이는 우정 레이싱: 레이서 하츄핑과 깡총핑의 탄생

206038.description:
Step into the world of Catch! Teenieping like never before—where speed meets sparkle and friendship fuels the finish line. In this special animated spin-off, Hyundai introduces Heartsping and Hoppingping, two rookie racers joining their very first racing team!

Note: Premiered as part of the Youth Adventure 2025 exhibition at the Hyundai Motorstudio in Goyang, Korea

206032.description: Music video directed by YM for the song ZIG-ZAG by Lui Takane.

206059.description: Music video directed by StudioXD for the song BAZUBI BAZAB by Towa Tokoyami

206362.description:
Music video directed by Ayume Kuroshima for the song One Last Wish by DADA GAUGUIN.

Note: There exists 2 versions of this song, the original sung by DADA GAUGUIN released on July 12, 2025, and a SynthV version featuring Kasane Teto released on Aug 1, 2025. The SynthV version features other visuals as well.

206888.description: Unaired episode 13 of Musashino!, released exclusively as a bonus on Crunchyroll.
synonyms: むさしの！夏の日と、部活と、友達と
Musashino!: Natsu no Hi to, Bukatsu to, Tomodachi to

206277.description:
"I came from the wilderness, raised by five incredibly powerful grandparents. To uncover the truth behind my parents' murder, I return to the city."

Watch as this young hero, skilled in martial arts, music, chess, medicine, and cooking, feigns weakness to outsmart others, surrounded by beautiful women, rises against all odds, solves a shocking mystery, and vows to become the city's all-around master, the undisputed ruler of this land!

(Source: iQIYI, translated)

206284.description: Pan Gaofeng, a young rocket development engineer born in the 1980s, joined the First Academy of Aerospace Science and Technology, the cradle of my country's launch vehicles, after graduating from graduate school. He was fortunate to be a member of the development team for the Long March 5 (CZ-5), my country's most powerful launch vehicle. Working alongside his predecessors and colleagues, he overcame numerous difficulties, overcame obstacles, and defied external ridicule and skepticism. He rose from the ashes of a failed launch to ultimately achieve success, marking a crucial step in my country's transition from a major space power to a leading space power.

206274.description:
To resist invasions from other worlds, the Heavenly Great Sage founded Tianguan Academy. Every year, the Academy would recruit new students—but in the end, only nine could become the official Heavenly Officers. Gu Tian, a young soccer player, accidentally awakened his hidden power while saving someone on the field. Invited by his senior Xia Zhi, he boarded Subway Line 36 to Tianguan Academy. With the world's finest teachers, strict assessments, and a brutal elimination system, the Academy pushes its students to the limit. By a stroke of fortune, Gu Tian became the 81st student to pass the entrance trial. Under the guidance of celestial masters, he studied spells and divine decrees, honed his combat skills against powerful rivals, and strode forward step by step toward the ultimate goal of becoming one of the Nines.

(Source: Youku, translated)

title.romaji: Watashi wo Shiranai France ni Ai ni Iku
title.native: 私を知らないフランスに会いに行く

206516.description: Commercial directed by Ryouchimo made for Explore France's 2024 tourism campaign.

title.romaji: Anata no France wa Donna Tokoro?

title.english: Heroes: Legend of the Battle Disks
title.native: ヒーローズ ～バトルディスク伝説～

206517.description:
The story is set in the galaxy located near the center of the universe.

There are Planet Aernia (a planet for Heroes) and Planet Orbs (a planet for robots), governed by Orbiton, in this same galaxy.

Various countries are present in Planet Aernia; they are, Volculm (volcanic country of fire), Zylan (oceanic country of water), Elvan (green-rich country of forest), and Aleum (celestial country of clouds).

Antania, is a nucleus of all the present countries. It has an academy that fosters Heroes.

Under the reign of the Governor General, Antania upholds a national policy to train Heroes to prevent Planet Aernia to be infringed by the Dark Desire.

Heroes are not only the reliable source of battle who have special abilities to freely use the battle discs, but also a symbol of unfailing justice.
synonyms: HEROES(ヒーローズ)～Legend of Battle Disks～
Heroes: A Lenda dos Discos de Batalha

206289.description: After a magnetic storm strikes the Blue Star Continent, spiritual energy is revived, transforming both humans and animals. This triggers a battle for survival between spirit beasts and humans. Ling Tian, a young prodigy with an ancient divine bloodline and a treasure called the 'God Brain,' discovers that in three years, the continent will face a disaster that will lead to his heroic death. Guided by Yan Ling, his assistant from the future, he embarks on a mission to attain ultimate power and change the continent's fate.

206292.description:
One day, Li Wuwang suddenly awakens to find himself, as the villain, kidnapping Wan Zheng, the Holy Maiden of the Wan Chao Sect, and fleeing. Before Li Wuwang can even react, the "system" that appears before him quickly issues him a mission: strip the Destiny Points of the chosen one. Either complete the mission and survive, or fail and become an ant dying under the sword of the chosen protagonist.

(Source: Youku, translated)
synonyms: The Public Enemy of the Immortal World

206151.description: In this fantasy world, where everyone is human and retains their animal features, the inhabitants live a peaceful life. For his next book, novelist Su Bai comes to the hometown of his good friend Avena Nanxia, a terraced village far away in the mountains, where he meets the lively and lovely Cu Nian Nian. Farming, picking, eating, catching fish ...... The daily life in the mountains and fields is always interesting.

title.english: The Boxfish and the Sea of Minamata
title.native: ハコフグとみなまたの海

206353.description:
The boxfish has no confidence in himself, he always spends his time alone on the rocks watching the other fish, feeling envious.

"Everyone else is so lucky. All I do is float back and forth in the same place on these rocks every day..."

Then one day, he meets a lost sea horse who seems to have come from the Minamata ocean, he then decides to embark on his first ever adventure to return the fish to the Minamata's sea...

(Source: Official Website, translated)

title.native: ダンジョン＆テレビジョン パイロットフィルム

title.romaji: Lei Su Deng: Yi Fei Chong Tian

206266.description: Hover Champs tells the story of some boys who compete in remote-controlled helicopters: Matthew and Zoe. Matthew is a 13-year-old boy who returns, with his mother, to the town where he was born. There he meets Zoe, a girl with great ability to drive remote-controlled helicopters. Matthew manages, on the first day, to break Zoe's record and she proposes that he form a team to compete together.

Yi Fei Chong Tian: Tianji Zhang Qi
